end.summary:
Asha practised counting sides and corners of 2D shapes.
Ayaan counted four sides on a kite and identified three sides and three corners of a triangle.
They recognised that turning a triangle does not change its three sides or corners.
They identified a rectangle as having four sides and four corners, using a book example.
Star-side counting was uncertain, and the teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners, including shapes turned in different directions. Ayaan used the method of counting each side and correctly explained that a triangle still has three sides and three corners when turned. They mixed up the star’s sides and were unsure how to count them. At home, show one shape at a time and have Ayaan trace and count each side and corner aloud, including a star.
